saintfeast.title: Mark, Aristarchos, and Zenon, Apostles of the 70

hymn.title: Apolytikion of Apostles Mark, Aristarchus, and Zenon in the Third Tone
hymn.shorttitle: Apolytikion of Apostles Mark, Aristarchus, and Zenon

translation.body: O Holy Apostle Aristarchus, intercede to our merciful God, that He may grant our souls forgiveness of sins.
